Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. 🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in ¾” inch pieces 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 3/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 cup green enchilada sauce or tomatillo salsa, divided 1 can pinto beans, drained 2 tablespoons melted butter 8 6-inch flour tortillas 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 cup sour cream Shredded lettuce and any other desired toppings Directions: Preheat oven to 375. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken pieces well with garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin. Fold in half and repeat with remaining tortillas, filling and cheese to fill the baking dish with side by side tacos. Top with any remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tops of each tortilla are golden brown and toasted and cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, stir together remaining salsa with sour cream until well combined. One stick of butter, a handful of simple ingredients, and a whole house filled with the smell of love. 🧈✨ This is my grandmother's Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice… the kind of easy chicken and rice casserole that simmers with memory and makes you feel held before the first bite. Chicken thighs baked over rice with French onion soup, beef consommé, mushrooms, Parmesan, and a whole stick of butter. It tastes like legacy and everything good. One dish, minimal prep, and a homemade family dinner that feels like a hug. 🤍 INGREDIENTS: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-oz) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5-oz) cans condensed beef consommé 8 oz baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan, divided 1 stick salted butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Seasoning 1¼ tsp kosher salt ¾ tsp freshly ground black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika To finish (optional) 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley DIRECTIONS: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 2. In a 9×13 baking dish, stir together the rice, French onion soup, beef consommé, and chopped mushrooms. Spread everything into an even layer. 3. Sprinkle ¾ cup of the cheese over the rice mixture, then dot the top with the pieces of butter. 4. Season the chicken thighs evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Arrange the chicken on top of the rice mixture. 5. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the chicken, then cover the dish tightly with foil. 6. Bake for 45 minutes. 7. Remove the foil and continue baking for about 20 minutes, until the top is golden, the rice has absorbed the liquid, and the chicken is cooked through and tender. 8. Let it rest for a few minutes, then finish with fresh parsley if you like. #StickOfButterChickenAndRice #ChickenAndRiceCasserole #ComfortFoodRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas #FamilyRecipe

Making that viral high-protein crockpot marry me chicken, but with a hormone-supportive upgrade. 🍲✨ When you’re navigating PCOS and prepping your body to conceive, keeping blood sugar steady and getting in nutrient-dense protein is everything. Swapping in chicken thighs gives you extra iron, zinc, and healthy fats, while bone broth brings in glycine and gut-supporting amino acids for that uterine lining.  I left out the red pepper flakes so Mila could eat dinner right along with us, and divided the rest into 8 meal prep containers for easy grab-and-go lunches. 🤍 Ingredients (Makes 8 servings):** • 2.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 1 cup organic chicken bone broth • 1 small onion, diced • 4 tsp minced garlic • 1 cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped • 1 tbsp paprika • 1 tbsp garlic powder • 1.5 tbsp Italian seasoning • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp red pepper flakes (optional — omit for toddlers!) High-Protein Cream Sauce: • 1 cup 2% cottage cheese (200g) • 1 cup 0% plain Greek yogurt (240g) • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 2–4 tbsp warm bone broth from the crockpot Stir-ins: • 2 cups freshly grated parmesan (200g) • 2–3 cups fresh baby spinach • 2.5 cups dry jasmine rice (cooked) Instructions: Add chicken thighs, bone broth, onion, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and seasonings (plus red pepper flakes if using) to the crockpot. Cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3–4 hours). Shred the chicken directly in the pot. Blend the sauce ingredients with a splash of the warm broth until completely smooth, then pour into the crockpot. Stir in parmesan and baby spinach until melted and wilted. Fold in cooked jasmine rice, stir until creamy, and divide into 8 containers! Macros per serving (1 of 8): • Calories: ~560 kcal • Protein: 48g • Carbs: 56g • Fat: 16g Save this for your next Sunday reset!
